AUTH_REQUIRED.summary: Gated route without a valid session

SESSION_REVOKED.summary: Refresh token reused or session revoked

VENUE_CONTEXT_REQUIRED.summary: Partner call without X-Venue-Id or X-Provider-Id

OTP_INVALID.summary: Wrong code; params.remainingAttempts says how many tries are left before OTP_LOCKED

CREDENTIALS_INVALID.summary: Wrong identifier or password (identical for unknown accounts)

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.summary: Same key with a different body

PRECONDITION_FAILED.summary: If-Match did not match the current ETag

BOOKING_STATE_CONFLICT.summary: Compare-and-swap lost; body carries currentStatus and currentVersion

QUOTE_CHANGED.summary: Quote repriced since it was shown

LEAD_TIME_TOO_SHORT.summary: Event date inside the minimum lead time

GUESTS_OUT_OF_RANGE.summary: Guests outside the package or hall range

AUDIENCE_NOT_ALLOWED.summary: Audience not allowed by the hall

VOUCHER_NOT_OFFERED.summary: The saving does not beat the voucher fee for this quote

VOUCHER_TARGET_MISMATCH.summary: Voucher is bound to another venue or provider

VOUCHER_OTHER_PARTNER.summary: Voucher belongs to another venue or provider

VOUCHER_NOT_CONFIRMED.summary: Client has not confirmed the request yet

CREDIT_NOT_ELIGIBLE.summary: Voucher is not eligible for a credit voucher request

REFUND_REQUEST_EXISTS.summary: A refund request for this voucher already exists

UNDO_WINDOW_ENDED.summary: The 8 s approval undo window passed

PLAN_RATES_NOT_ANNOUNCED.summary: Plan rates are not decided; the pay step is disabled

LISTING_NOT_EDITABLE.summary: Listing status does not allow this edit

LISTING_STATE_CONFLICT.summary: Listing is not in a status that allows this command

REVIEW_ALREADY_REPLIED.summary: A venue replies to a review once

REVIEW_NOT_ALLOWED.summary: Request not completed or already reviewed

VISIT_STATE_CONFLICT.summary: Visit is not in a status that allows this command

STAFF_LAST_ADMIN.summary: The last Admin cannot be removed or demoted

EMAIL_ALREADY_INVITED.summary: A pending invitation for this email exists

EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED.summary: A partner account already uses this email (sign in instead; a rejected applicant resubmits from the signed-in form)

APPLICATION_NOT_ACCEPTED.summary: The partner application is pending or rejected; only an accepted account can create listings

APPLICATION_NOT_EDITABLE.summary: Only a rejected application can be edited and sent again
